chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Abbas al-Baqqaq, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): A man marions a female slave without the knowledge of her owners. He said: It is fornication. Indeed, Allah the Exalted says: 'So marry them with the permission of their owners.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a female slave without her owner's permission in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elevates the requirement of the owner's consent (*idhn*) from a mere procedural formality to a substantive condition of validity, equating its absence to *zina* (fornication). This ruling underscores the distinct legal status of female slaves (*ummat*) in Shia jurisprudence, where the master's right of ownership intersects with the contractual integrity of marriage, distinguishing it from the free woman's marriage contract.
